types.name: marketdata.v1.AssetConfig
types.doc: AssetConfig describes one spot asset returned by GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: asset
fields.doc: Asset code, e.g. "USDT" or "BTC".

fields.name: ledger_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric asset id used by account, balance, and order APIs.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Human-friendly display name, e.g. "Bitcoin".

fields.name: quantity_display_decimals
fields.doc: Suggested decimal precision for displaying user-facing asset amounts.

fields.name: quantity_scale
fields.doc:
Integer scale for quantities and balances in this asset (0..18).
 A scale of 8 means one whole asset is represented as 100000000 in scaled
 integer fields such as qty_scaled.

types.name: marketdata.v1.Candle
types.doc: Candle represents a single OHLCV bucket for a symbol and timeframe.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: numeric spot market identifier

fields.name: timeframe
fields.doc: timeframe of this candle

fields.name: ts_sec
fields.doc: bucket start timestamp (seconds since epoch, UTC)

fields.name: open
fields.doc: opening price in quote units scaled by 1e6

fields.name: high
fields.doc: highest traded price in quote units scaled by 1e6

fields.name: low
fields.doc: lowest traded price in quote units scaled by 1e6

fields.name: close
fields.doc: closing price in quote units scaled by 1e6

fields.name: volume
fields.doc:
Traded base-asset quantity scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from
 GetSpotConfig.

types.name: marketdata.v1.CandlePoint
types.doc:
CandlePoint is one OHLCV bucket represented with scaled integers.

 REST responses render these values as decimal strings in tuple order:
 [ts_sec, open, high, low, close, volume].

fields.name: ts_sec
fields.doc: Candle bucket start timestamp, in seconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: open
fields.doc: Opening price in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: high
fields.doc: Highest traded price in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: low
fields.doc: Lowest traded price in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: close
fields.doc: Closing price in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: volume
fields.doc:
Traded base-asset quantity scaled by the market's base asset quantity_scale
 from GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: is_closed
fields.doc:
True only for WebSocket terminal updates of a closed bucket.
 Historical API rows and current open-candle rows set this to false.

types.name: marketdata.v1.GetCandlesColumnsRequest
types.doc:
GetCandlesColumnsRequest selects a spot market candle series for columnar output.

 The response is ordered oldest-first for efficient chart ingestion. When both
 start_time and end_time are set, both bounds are inclusive.

cel.message: end_time must be >= start_time when both are set
start_time and end_time must not be more than 5 minutes in the future
cel.expression: (!has(this.start_time) || this.start_time <= now + duration('300s')) && (!has(this.end_time) || this.end_time <= now + duration('300s'))

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier.

fields.name: timeframe
fields.doc: Candle bucket size. Required for ConnectRPC clients.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of closed candles to return. Defaults to 500 when unset;
 max 10000.

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc:
Inclusive lower bound for candle bucket start time, as a UTC timestamp.
 Must not be more than 5 minutes in the future.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc:
Inclusive upper bound for candle bucket start time, as a UTC timestamp.
 Must be greater than or equal to start_time when both are set, and must not
 be more than 5 minutes in the future.

fields.name: include_incomplete
fields.doc:
Include the current open candle when it is available and inside the
 requested range.
 The open candle is prepended to the newest-first candle list and does not
 count toward the closed-candle limit.

fields.name: include_reference
fields.doc:
Include the composite reference market candle series for the same market,
 timeframe, and time range.
 The reference series can be empty when no reference series is available for
 the requested timeframe.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to symbol, timeframe, time bounds, and oldest-first candle ordering.
 Inclusion flags and columnar response shape may change between pages.

types.name: marketdata.v1.GetCandlesColumnsResponse
types.doc:
GetCandlesColumnsResponse returns the same candle series as GetCandles but in columnar form.
 This is optimized for charting clients that ingest arrays of each field (binary only).

 Ordering: values are returned oldest-first (ascending ts_sec).

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier.

fields.name: timeframe
fields.doc: Timeframe of this series.

fields.name: ts_sec
fields.doc: Candle bucket start timestamps (seconds since epoch, UTC).

fields.name: open
fields.doc: Opening prices in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: high
fields.doc: Highest traded prices in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: low
fields.doc: Lowest traded prices in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: close
fields.doc: Closing prices in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: volume
fields.doc:
Traded base-asset quantities scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from
 GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: reference_ts_sec
fields.doc:
Reference candle series in columnar form (same ordering as ts_sec: oldest-first).
 Only populated when request.include_reference=true.

fields.name: reference_open
fields.doc: Reference opening prices in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: reference_high
fields.doc: Reference high prices in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: reference_low
fields.doc: Reference low prices in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: reference_close
fields.doc: Reference closing prices in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: reference_volume
fields.doc:
Reference traded base-asset quantities scaled by the pair's
 base_quantity_scale from GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: marketdata.v1.GetCandlesRequest
types.doc:
GetCandlesRequest selects a spot market candle series.

 The response is ordered newest-first by candle bucket start time. When both
 start_time and end_time are set, both bounds are inclusive.

cel.message: end_time must be >= start_time when both are set
start_time and end_time must not be more than 5 minutes in the future
cel.expression: (!has(this.start_time) || this.start_time <= now + duration('300s')) && (!has(this.end_time) || this.end_time <= now + duration('300s'))

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier.

fields.name: timeframe
fields.doc: Candle bucket size. Required for ConnectRPC clients.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of closed candles to return. Defaults to 500 when unset;
 max 10000.

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc:
Inclusive lower bound for candle bucket start time, as a UTC timestamp.
 Must not be more than 5 minutes in the future.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc:
Inclusive upper bound for candle bucket start time, as a UTC timestamp.
 Must be greater than or equal to start_time when both are set, and must not
 be more than 5 minutes in the future.

fields.name: include_incomplete
fields.doc:
Include the current open candle when it is available and inside the
 requested range.
 The open candle is prepended to the newest-first candle list and does not
 count toward the closed-candle limit.

fields.name: include_reference
fields.doc:
Include the composite reference market candle series for the same market,
 timeframe, and time range.
 The reference series can be empty when no reference series is available for
 the requested timeframe.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to symbol, timeframe, time bounds, and newest-first candle ordering.
 Inclusion flags affect response enrichment and may change between pages.

types.name: marketdata.v1.GetCandlesResponse
types.doc:
GetCandlesResponse contains OHLCV candles for one spot market and timeframe.

 Candles and reference_candles are ordered newest-first by ts_sec. REST
 responses render price and volume values as decimal strings.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier echoed from the request.

fields.name: timeframe
fields.doc: Candle bucket size used for the returned series.

fields.name: candles
fields.doc: Primary market candle series, ordered newest-first by ts_sec.

fields.name: reference_candles
fields.doc:
Composite reference market candle series, ordered newest-first by ts_sec.
 Populated only when include_reference is true and reference data is
 available.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: marketdata.v1.GetOrderbookHeatmapRequest
types.doc: GetOrderbookHeatmapRequest fetches historical heatmap buckets.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier.

fields.name: interval
fields.doc: Heatmap bucket interval.

fields.name: depth
fields.doc: Top-N levels per side included in each bucket.

fields.name: time_range
fields.doc:
Absolute time range for the first page. Reuse the same request filters and
 pass page_token from the prior response to continue older buckets.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to symbol, interval, depth, quantity mode, and the original time
 range.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc:
Maximum number of delta buckets returned (min 1, max 20000).
 This limit counts only `chain.deltas`; `chain.base_keyframe` is not counted.

fields.name: quantity_mode
fields.doc:
Quantity mode used for qty_scaled in snapshot/delta levels:
 - CLOSE: end-of-bucket quantity
 - PEAK: intra-bucket peak quantity

types.name: marketdata.v1.GetOrderbookHeatmapResponse
types.doc:
GetOrderbookHeatmapResponse returns a historical replay chain plus optional
 live bucket state for explicit realtime stitching.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier returned for the requested market.

fields.name: interval
fields.doc: Bucket interval used for the returned chain.

fields.name: depth
fields.doc: Top-N depth requested per side.

fields.name: chain
fields.doc: Always returned as snapshot + sparse deltas for the requested interval.

fields.name: last_persisted_ts_sec
fields.doc: Latest finalized historical bucket timestamp in seconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: live_from_book_seq_end
fields.doc: Book sequence anchor for realtime continuation; apply live updates where book_seq_end is greater than this value.

fields.name: has_live_anchor
fields.doc: True when live_from_book_seq_end is available and can be used as a realtime continuation anchor.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

fields.name: server_time_sec
fields.doc: Server response time in seconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: quantity_mode
fields.doc: Quantity mode used for all qty_scaled values in the response.

fields.name: live_bucket
fields.doc:
Optional latest live bucket for the requested interval and depth.
 Present only when it is newer than the historical anchor and its quantity semantics match quantity_mode.

types.name: marketdata.v1.GetSpotConfigRequest
types.doc: GetSpotConfigRequest has no parameters.

types.name: marketdata.v1.GetSpotConfigResponse
types.doc: GetSpotConfigResponse contains a cacheable spot reference-data snapshot.

fields.name: assets
fields.doc: Assets ordered by asset code in ascending alphabetical order.

fields.name: pairs
fields.doc: Pairs ordered by symbol in ascending alphabetical order.

fields.name: ts_sec
fields.doc: Snapshot generation timestamp, in seconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

types.name: marketdata.v1.GetTradesRequest
types.doc:
GetTradesRequest selects recent public trades for one spot market.

 Results are ordered newest-first by execution timestamp, with match_id as a
 tie-breaker. When both start_time and end_time are set, both bounds are
 inclusive.

cel.message: end_time must be >= start_time when both are set
start_time and end_time must not be more than 5 minutes in the future
cel.expression: (!has(this.start_time) || this.start_time <= now + duration('300s')) && (!has(this.end_time) || this.end_time <= now + duration('300s'))

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric pair id from GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum number of trades to return. Defaults to 100 when unset; max 1000.

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc:
Inclusive lower bound for trade execution time. Must not be more than
 5 minutes in the future.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc:
Inclusive upper bound for trade execution time. Must be greater than or
 equal to start_time when both are set, and must not be more than 5 minutes
 in the future.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Optional filter by trade aggressor side. Unspecified returns both sides.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to symbol, time bounds, side filter, and newest-first sort order.

types.name: marketdata.v1.GetTradesResponse
types.doc: GetTradesResponse contains public trades for one spot market.

fields.name: trades
fields.doc:
Trades ordered newest-first by execution timestamp, with match_id as a
 tie-breaker.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: marketdata.v1.HeatmapDeltaBucket
types.doc: HeatmapDeltaBucket is one sparse update bucket containing both sides.

fields.name: ts_sec
fields.doc: Bucket start timestamp (seconds since epoch, UTC), aligned to `interval`.

fields.name: bids
fields.doc: Sparse bid-side level changes in this bucket.

fields.name: asks
fields.doc: Sparse ask-side level changes in this bucket.

fields.name: updates_in_bucket
fields.doc: Number of upstream L2 updates aggregated into this interval bucket.

fields.name: book_seq_start
fields.doc: Earliest monotonic order book sequence represented by this bucket.

fields.name: book_seq_end
fields.doc: Latest monotonic order book sequence represented by this bucket.

types.name: marketdata.v1.HeatmapDeltaChain
types.doc:
HeatmapDeltaChain is the historical payload for all intervals.
 Reconstruct by applying deltas over base_keyframe.
 Deltas are ordered oldest-first by ts_sec.

fields.name: base_keyframe
fields.doc: Full-book snapshot from which to apply the returned deltas.

fields.name: deltas
fields.doc: Sparse update buckets ordered oldest-first by timestamp.

types.name: marketdata.v1.HeatmapDeltaLevels
types.doc:
HeatmapDeltaLevels represents sparse per-bucket level changes for one side.
 Arrays are aligned by index and prices are sorted ascending for both sides:
 - price_ticks[i] <-> qty_scaled[i]
 Delete semantics: qty_scaled[i] = 0 means delete level at price_ticks[i].

cel.message: price_ticks and qty_scaled must have equal lengths

fields.name: price_ticks
fields.doc: Price levels in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: qty_scaled
fields.doc:
Quantity at each price level, scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from
 GetSpotConfig. A zero value deletes the level at the matching price_ticks
 index.

types.name: marketdata.v1.HeatmapDepth
types.doc:
HeatmapDepth controls top-N levels included per side in each heatmap bucket.

 Values intentionally mirror orderbook.v1.Depth for FE ergonomics, while
 keeping this contract decoupled from orderbook service protos.

types.name: marketdata.v1.HeatmapInterval
types.doc: HeatmapInterval controls bucket resolution for historical orderbook heatmap.

types.name: marketdata.v1.HeatmapKeyframe
types.doc: HeatmapKeyframe is a full-book snapshot anchor.

fields.name: ts_sec
fields.doc: Snapshot timestamp (seconds since epoch, UTC).

fields.name: best_bid_ticks
fields.doc: Best bid price in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: best_ask_ticks
fields.doc: Best ask price in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: mid_ticks
fields.doc: Mid price in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: bids
fields.doc: Complete bid-side levels at the snapshot.

fields.name: asks
fields.doc: Complete ask-side levels at the snapshot.

fields.name: book_seq
fields.doc: Monotonic order book sequence at the snapshot.

types.name: marketdata.v1.HeatmapLevels
types.doc:
HeatmapLevels represents one side of the orderbook for snapshots.
 Arrays are aligned by index and prices are sorted ascending for both sides:
 - price_ticks[i] <-> qty_scaled[i]

cel.message: price_ticks and qty_scaled must have equal lengths

fields.name: price_ticks
fields.doc: Price levels in quote units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: qty_scaled
fields.doc:
Quantity at each price level according to quantity_mode, scaled by the
 pair's base_quantity_scale from GetSpotConfig.

types.name: marketdata.v1.HeatmapLiveBucket
types.doc:
HeatmapLiveBucket is the canonical live payload for real-time heatmap updates.
 It represents the latest state of one bucket (open or finalized).

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric spot market identifier.

fields.name: interval
fields.doc: Bucket interval for this payload.

fields.name: ts_sec
fields.doc: Bucket start timestamp (seconds since epoch, UTC), aligned to `interval`.

fields.name: is_final
fields.doc:
True when this bucket is finalized; false for provisional updates to an
 open bucket.

fields.name: bids
fields.doc: Sparse bid-side level changes represented by this bucket.

fields.name: asks
fields.doc: Sparse ask-side level changes represented by this bucket.

fields.name: updates_in_bucket
fields.doc: Number of upstream L2 updates aggregated into this interval bucket.

fields.name: book_seq_start
fields.doc: Earliest monotonic order book sequence represented by this bucket.

fields.name: book_seq_end
fields.doc: Latest monotonic order book sequence represented by this bucket.

fields.name: quantity_mode
fields.doc: Quantity semantics for qty_scaled in bids and asks.

fields.name: effective_bin_ticks
fields.doc:
Effective bin stride for this symbol as a price delta in 1e-6 quote-unit
 ticks.

types.name: marketdata.v1.HeatmapQuantityMode
types.doc: HeatmapQuantityMode controls what qty_scaled means in returned levels.

types.name: marketdata.v1.HeatmapTimeRange
types.doc:
HeatmapTimeRange selects historical buckets by [start_time, end_time] (UTC).
 At least one bound is required.

cel.message: at least one of start_time or end_time must be set
end_time must be >= start_time when both are set

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc: Inclusive lower bound in UTC. Omit to leave the lower bound open.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc: Inclusive upper bound in UTC. Omit to leave the upper bound open.

types.name: marketdata.v1.MarketTrade
types.doc:
MarketTrade is one public trade print represented with scaled integers.

 REST responses render price and quantity as decimal strings.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric pair id from GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: match_id
fields.doc: Stable trade id within the symbol, suitable for pagination and de-duplication.

fields.name: is_buy
fields.doc:
True when the taker/aggressor bought the base asset; false when the
 taker/aggressor sold the base asset.

fields.name: price_ticks
fields.doc: Trade price in quote-asset units scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: qty_scaled
fields.doc:
Traded base-asset quantity scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from
 GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Trade execution timestamp, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch (UTC).

types.name: marketdata.v1.PairConfig
types.doc: PairConfig describes one spot trading pair and its trading constraints.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric pair id used by low-latency ConnectRPC requests and streams.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Trading pair symbol, e.g. "BTC-USDT".

fields.name: base_asset
fields.doc: Base asset code. For BTC-USDT, this is "BTC".

fields.name: quote_asset
fields.doc: Quote asset code. For BTC-USDT, this is "USDT".

fields.name: tick_size
fields.doc:
Minimum allowed price increment as a decimal string in quote-asset units.
 Prices use 6 decimal places in scaled integer fields; for example "0.01"
 means orders must be priced in 0.01 quote-asset increments.

fields.name: step_size
fields.doc: Minimum allowed quantity increment as a decimal string in base-asset units.

fields.name: min_notional_quote
fields.doc: Minimum order notional as a decimal string in quote-asset units.

fields.name: min_qty_base
fields.doc: Minimum order quantity as a decimal string in base-asset units.

fields.name: allow_buy_fee_from_received
fields.doc:
Whether BUY order fees may be paid from the received base asset instead of
 the spent quote asset when the order request selects that fee source.

fields.name: base_quantity_scale
fields.doc: Quantity scale for base-asset amounts in this pair.

fields.name: quote_quantity_scale
fields.doc: Quantity scale for quote-asset amounts in this pair.

fields.name: marketdata
fields.doc: Market-data display settings for this pair.

fields.name: listing_at
fields.doc:
Scheduled listing timestamp. When unset, the pair has no explicit future
 listing time.

fields.name: delisting_at
fields.doc:
Scheduled delisting timestamp. When unset, the pair has no explicit
 delisting time.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current trading status.

fields.name: default_market_slippage_bps_buy
fields.doc:
Default MARKET order slippage cap for BUY orders, in basis points
 (1 bp = 0.01%). A request-level slippage setting can override this value.

fields.name: default_market_slippage_bps_sell
fields.doc:
Default MARKET order slippage cap for SELL orders, in basis points
 (1 bp = 0.01%). A request-level slippage setting can override this value.

fields.name: max_client_ref_drift_bps
fields.doc:
Maximum allowed drift between client reference price and server reference
 price for MARKET orders, in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%), when client
 reference pricing is used.

types.name: marketdata.v1.PairMarketdataConfig
types.doc: PairMarketdataConfig describes market-data display settings for a spot pair.

fields.name: orderbook_price_buckets
fields.doc:
Suggested order book aggregation bucket sizes in quote-asset price units,
 e.g. 0.01, 0.1, 1, or 10.

types.name: marketdata.v1.PairStatus
types.doc: PairStatus describes which order mutations a spot pair currently accepts.

values.name: PAIR_STATUS_ENABLED
values.doc: New orders and cancellations are accepted.

values.name: PAIR_STATUS_POST_ONLY
values.doc: New orders must use a post-only execution variant.

values.name: PAIR_STATUS_REDUCE_ONLY
values.doc: New spot orders are blocked by reduce-only policy.

types.name: marketdata.v1.SideFilter
types.doc: SideFilter controls which aggressor side of trades to return.

values.name: BUY
values.doc: Return trades where the taker/aggressor was buying the base asset.

values.name: SELL
values.doc: Return trades where the taker/aggressor was selling the base asset.

types.name: marketdata.v1.Timeframe
types.doc:
Timeframe represents an OHLCV candle bucket.

 Most values are fixed-duration buckets. `MONTH_1` is calendar-based (UTC
 month boundaries).
